## Research: questions 2, 4 and 5, from the code

Read-only, on `main` at 733409bf (2026-11-11). No builds and no timings: questions 1 and 3 still wait for #913. Every number is **counted** from the tree or from `git log` unless it says **estimated**. "14 days" means `git log --since="14 days ago" --no-merges` (969 commits).

Two corrections to the table in the issue: `cl` depends on `geometry` (`crates/cl/Cargo.toml`), and `app` now has 268 test files (#860 added `c_axis_unwind`).

### Q2 - test placement

Method: for each of the 268 files in `crates/app/tests/`, every `camcraft_app::` path it uses (its `mod` support modules included) was split into what `crates/app/src` defines and what `app/src/lib.rs` only re-exports from another crate (`cl`, `post`, `verify`, `sim`, `machining2d`, `drilling`, `probing`, `tools`, `geo2d`, `stock`; `app::machine::{Machine, parse_mch, Kind, ...}` is `camcraft_post::machine::*`). A file that uses nothing `app` defines is owned by another crate.

| Owner | Files | Tests | What it uses from `camcraft_app` | Seam needed to move |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| post - ready | 10 | 55 | re-exports only: `post::{engine, cnc, dump}`, `cl::*`, `machine::{parse_mch, Machine, Coolant, ...}` | none - change the import root, move the file |
| post - registry | 8 | 39 | the same, plus `posting::{MACHINES, BUILTINS, LATHE_POSTS, PLASMA_POSTS, post_serves}` | move those tables (`include_str!` data and one pure fn) to `camcraft-post`; `app::posting` re-exports them |
| post - probe input | 6 | 50 | the same, plus `probing::probe_cycle` (motion) to make the input toolpath | a recorded `.cl` input (`cl::text::to_text` / `from_text` exist), or a dev-dependency of post on motion |
| post - mixed | 1 | 8 | `arc_planes`: one test also uses `project::{ArcDto, ArcPlaneDto}` | that one test stays in app |
| sim - ready | 3 | 5 | `verify::*`, `stock_sim::*` re-exports; `warned_moves` (an app module of 121 lines that imports only cl, geometry and `verify::Warning`) | `warned_moves` moves to sim with its test; `stock_field_cost` reads the `.cl` goldens |
| sim - needs a generator | 5 | 36 | `verify` / `sim` / `stock_sim` re-exports, fed by motion generators (`machining2d`, `drilling`, `finishing3d`, `multiaxis`) | land in `crates/motion/tests` (motion already depends on sim) with a Gate map naming `sim::...` |
| motion | 3 | 33 | `machining2d`, `drilling`, `finishing3d`, `tools` re-exports; `common::{gen_to_cltext, write_golden}` | `arcs`: none. `golden_cl`: a home for the `.cl` goldens. `vertical_arc_entry`: also calls post |
| cl, tools, geometry | 0 | 0 | - | - |
| **not app** | **36** | **226** | | |
| app | 232 | 1658 | 200 import `commands` directly (221 counting support modules); 20 use `mcp` / `script` / `cli`; `import` and `tool_csys` test `app::geometry::import` | stay |

The files:
- post - ready: `heidenhain_arc_centre`, `heidenhain_block_form`, `heidenhain_cycles`, `probe_spindle`, `probe_spindle_stop`, `comment_escape`, `lathe_post_refusals`, `doosan_dnm_post`, `inverted_equivalence`, `inverted_post`
- post - registry: `carvera_machines`, `carvera_post`, `sinumerik_safe_retract`, `tormach_fourth_axis`, `tormach_lathes`, `tormach_safe_retract`, `conformance`, `plasma_post_refusals` (its one `default_post_for` assert returns `schema::PostRef` and stays)
- post - probe input: `fanuc_post`, `probe_dialects`, `probe_guard`, `probe_report`, `probe_tormach`, `inverted_probe`
- sim - ready: `boundary_walls`, `warned_moves`, `stock_field_cost`
- sim - needs a generator: `sim`, `verify`, `solid_law_goldens`, `posed_contact`, `stock_engine_agreement`
- motion: `arcs`, `golden_cl`, `vertical_arc_entry`

**The 10 cheapest moves** (no seam; they read scripts and goldens by repo path, which resolves the same from any crate): to post - `heidenhain_arc_centre`, `heidenhain_block_form`, `heidenhain_cycles`, `probe_spindle`, `probe_spindle_stop`, `comment_escape`, `lathe_post_refusals`, `doosan_dnm_post`; to sim - `boundary_walls`; to motion - `arcs`. Next: `inverted_equivalence` and `inverted_post` (their helper `inverted_support` is also used by `inverted_axis_display`, which stays in app).

**Hardest blockers**
1. **The goldens have three owners.** `crates/app/tests/golden/*.cl` (29 files) are written by `golden_cl` (motion behaviour), read as input by the post tests (`conformance`, `fanuc_post`, `doosan_dnm_post`, `arc_planes`, `heidenhain_*`) and by `common::engine_fixtures` (the stock engines of sim). They need one home before `golden_cl` moves, and the quick tier only treats `crates/<c>/tests/**` as shared test input of crate `c`.
2. **post and motion are siblings.** The 6 probe files and `vertical_arc_entry` need both; `app` is the only crate that sees both. A recorded `.cl` file is the low-coupling seam; a dev-dependency is the cheap one.
3. **The release heavy lane runs only motion and app** (`xtask/src/plan.rs`, `release()`). `stock_field_cost` (1 ignored test) would fall out of the release tier if it moved to sim unchanged.
4. **`tests/common/mod.rs` mixes two things**: helpers that need only `cl` (`gen_to_cltext`, `write_golden`, `cl_read`, `engine_fixtures`) and document helpers (`create_past_the_tool_law`, `bore`, `rotary_bar`). The first half has to be split out for the moved files.
5. **Dialect tests that drive a document stay.** At least 26 files (counted in a sample of 39 post-flavoured files: `tormach_post`, `lathe_post*`, `coolant`, `after_op`, `per_op_files`, `program_comments`, `control_comp`, ...) assert on posted text but get their record stream from `posting::stream_records` / `op_streams` over a `World` built with commands. Moving the dialect half needs recorded `.cnc` streams (`cnc::serialize` / `parse` exist). Not counted as movable.

**Misplaced in the other crates:** `crates/motion/tests/real_tip.rs` imports only cl, geometry and `verify` and its Gate map says `camcraft_sim::verify` - it belongs in sim. `crates/motion/tests/origin_approach.rs` imports only cl and geometry - it belongs in cl. Nothing misplaced in `crates/sim/tests`.

**Found on the way - the quick tier already skips most of these suites.** `quick.rs` matches a changed module of another crate as `<crate>::<module>`. 86 of the 268 app suites still name a module that M4.1 moved as `app::<module>` (emulated with the regex from `quick.rs`). So a change under `crates/post/src/post/` picks 3 app suites of the 28 that name `app::post`; a change under `crates/sim/src/verify/` picks 6 of 33; `crates/motion/src/machining2d/` picks 3 of 29. `heidenhain_cycles` has no Gate map at all. And quick maps only paths under `crates/`: a diff that touches only `assets/posts/*.cps` selects no suite (27 such commits in 14 days; 25 of them also changed an app test, which is what ran). The misplaced tests cost less in quick than the issue assumes, because they are not selected - which is a coverage hole, not a saving. Moving a test into its owner crate fixes both: own-crate maps match on `::<module>`.

### Q4 - coupling

**The graph today** (from the `Cargo.toml` files; no crate has a dev-dependency on a workspace crate):
`geometry` <- `cl` <- `post`; `tools` (no deps); `sim` -> cl, geometry, tools; `motion` -> cl, geometry, sim, tools; `app` -> all six; `ui` -> app; `kernel` stands alone. #880 adds `post` -> `tools`.

| Edge | Source files using it | Distinct items | What | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| post -> tools (#880, open) | 1 new file | 2 | `holder_library::find`, `HolderEntry` | invert: the caller passes the lookup in, or the check lives in `app::machine::validate`. Keeps post on cl and geometry |
| motion -> tools | 4 of 191 | 2 | `Tool`, `ToolKind` (drilling) | thin, but cutting it alone saves nothing: tools still arrives through sim |
| sim -> tools | 12 of 99 (all in `verify/`) | 4 | `ToolGeom`, `HolderStack`, `Tool`, `ToolKind` | thin by count; cutting needs a lower home for 4 data types. `tools.rs` is the file that changes most in tools (10 of its 20 commits in 14 days), so there is no stable half to split off. Leave |
| motion -> sim, verify part | 7 of 191 | 3 | `verify::{Warning, crossed_pairs, crossing}` | thin - can be cut if these three move below |
| motion -> sim, stock part | 10 of 191 | 13 | `stock_sim::{Stock, Columns, Backend, StockError, SimOp, ...}` | real: rest machining reads the stock model. Keep |
| post -> geometry | 2 of 24 | 4 | `Point2`, `Point3`, `units` | reachable through cl; cutting saves no rebuild. Leave |
| post -> cl, sim -> cl, sim -> geometry, motion -> cl, motion -> geometry, cl -> geometry | 11/24, 45/99, 80/99, 101/191, 172/191, 14/20 | 8-25 | the shared vocabulary (`Point3`, `Move`, `Toolpath`, ...) | keep |
| app -> motion / sim / cl | 51 / 31 / 68 of 302 | many | 35 / 15 / 36 of those files are in `app::operation` | `operation` is the one real consumer |
| app -> post | 9 of 302, plus the `machine` re-export | | `posting*`, `smoothing`, `machine` | keep |

Inside sim there are two halves that barely touch: `verify` (56 commits in 14 days) and `stock_sim` (61). `verify` reads `stock_sim` in 4 files; `stock_sim` reads `verify` for one type (`RotaryAxis`).

**`app` modules as crates.** The non-test code of `app` has one knot: 29 modules, 42.6k lines, strongly connected (`operation`, `schema`, `model`, `machine`, `posting`, `stock_sim`, `rest`, `setup*`, `fixture*`, `pick`, ...). `commands` + `project` + `tool_library` (16.3k lines) sit strictly above it, and `mcp`, `script`, `cli` and the view modules above those. Only 3 knot files point back up at `commands` / `project`, all in test code.

| Candidate | Lines | App modules it imports | Imported by | Test files that follow | Commits in 14 days that would skip an `app` rebuild | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mcp` + `script` + `cli` | 5.2k | 23 | 1 (`cli`), plus ui | 20 | 14 of 362 | cleanest cut; small saving |
| `commands` + `project` + views, above a core crate | about 27k above, 43k below | - | ui | about 220 stay above; almost none follow the core | 53 of 362 (the 14 above included) | large work, 15% of app commits benefit |
| `geometry::import` | 1.6k | 0 | via the `geometry` re-export | 2 (`import`, `tool_csys`, 34 tests) | 5 commits touch it | trivial to cut, nearly nothing saved |
| `operation` | 25.2k | 19 | 20 | - | - | not separable: inside the knot (`schema` and `operation` import each other) |
| `machine`, `stock_sim`, `posting` | 2.4k, 1.2k, 2.5k | 9, 12, 20 | 15, 14, 9 | - | - | inside the knot |

Of the 362 commits that touched `crates/app/src` in 14 days, 172 touched the knot and 137 also touched a domain crate: 309 rebuild all of app however it is split. Splitting app is the elegant move and the poor saving.

**Ranked by expected rebuild saving** (a proxy until #913 gives timings: commits in 14 days that benefit x lines of crate they no longer rebuild; both counted, the product is an **estimate** of rank, not of minutes):
1. Move the 36 tests out of app. 7 post-only source commits and 25 script-only commits pinned their change with an app test; each needed app (72k lines) built and linked to run it. Cheapest by far.
2. Split sim into the stock model and `verify`, with motion on the stock model only: up to 56 commits spare motion (46.6k lines, 65 suites).
3. Layer app (core below `commands` / `project`): 53 commits spare 43k lines. Largest work.
4. Cut both tools edges (sim, motion): 20 commits spare 70k lines, but needs a new home for 4 types.
5. `mcp` crate: 14 commits spare 67k lines.
6. Keep post off tools: small today (post is 6k lines), but post is where about 25 more suites should land, and every one would relink on a tools change.

### Q5 - proposed rules for AGENTS.md "Code shape"

- **A test lives with the code it tests.** A new test file goes in the lowest crate that provides everything it imports. A file in `crates/app/tests/` must use something `crates/app/src` defines (a command, the project file, the schema, an operation, posting, MCP); a test that imports only re-exports (`app::post`, `app::verify`, `app::machining2d`, ...) goes in that crate. Its Gate map names the real crate (`post::engine`, not `app::post`). A test that needs output of another crate as input reads a recorded file (`.cl`, `.cnc`); it does not import the generator.
  *Last week:* 229 test files were added to `crates/app/tests` in 7 days; 30 of them use nothing app defines and would have gone to post (23), sim (6) and motion (1).

- **No new edge between our crates without a decision.** A `camcraft-*` line added to `[dependencies]` or `[dev-dependencies]` of any `crates/*/Cargo.toml` needs a `docs/decisions/` entry in the same PR that lists the items imported, says why the caller cannot pass the value in instead (a parameter, a closure, a recorded file), and names the crates and test binaries that now rebuild when the dependency changes. An edge that would carry fewer than five items is not added: the caller passes the value in.
  *Last week:* no merged commit added one. Open PR #880 adds post -> tools for 2 items; it has a decision file, and under the five-item clause the holder check would take the lookup from app instead.

- **`app` holds the document, nothing else.** New code goes in `crates/app/src` only if it reads or writes the ECS world, the project file, a command, MCP or the CLI. A new file there that names no `World`, entity or `schema` type belongs in the domain crate that owns its inputs; `app` may re-export it.
  *Last week:* `warned_moves` (cl, geometry and `verify::Warning` only) would have gone to sim and `path_sig` (cl only) to cl; the post and machine registries in `posting.rs` are the older case of the same thing.

- **A new test joins a suite before it starts one.** Every `crates/*/tests/<name>.rs` is its own binary and links its whole crate. A new test is added to the suite that already covers the module, as a function or as a module of the directory of that suite; a new top-level test file needs a line in the PR saying why no existing suite fits.
  *Evidence:* app has 268 binaries; 75 hold 3 tests or fewer and 133 hold 5 or fewer; seven name families (`lathe`, `turning`, `fixture`, `mcp`, `probe`, `setup`, `tool`) are 89 files. #860 added `c_axis_unwind` beside `c_axis_live` with the same imports and fixture. **Adopt only after question 3 is measured and xtask understands directory suites:** today `scan::binaries` lists `tests/*.rs` only, and quick treats a changed `tests/<dir>/x.rs` as shared input and runs every suite of the crate. With the 400-line rule and no directory suites, this rule cannot be followed.

### Proposed sub-issues

Order is by **estimated** gate saving per unit of work. All `area:build`, `source:agent`, "Part of #919". Not filed; labels untouched.

| Order | Title | Done means | P | Effort |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | AGENTS.md: the test-placement, crate-edge and app-content rules | The three rules the maintainer accepts are in "Code shape" and "Testing" (which still says `crates/app/tests/` is "app + commands"), and the PR-review checklist names them | P1 | low |
| 2 | Move the 10 no-seam tests out of app, and 2 out of motion | The 8 post, 1 sim and 1 motion files listed above, plus `real_tip` -> sim and `origin_approach` -> cl, compile in their owner crate with no `camcraft_app` import; Gate maps name the real crate; the `#[test]` count is the same before and after | P1 | medium |
| 3 | Gate maps name the crate that owns the module | No suite names a moved module as `app::<module>` (86 suites today); `heidenhain_cycles` has a map; an xtask unit test pins that a `crates/post/src/post/` change selects the post dialect suites | P1 | medium |
| 4 | Quick tier: a post script or machine file change selects its suites | A diff touching only `assets/posts/*.cps` or `assets/machines/*.mch` selects the suites whose Gate map names that asset; pinned by xtask unit tests | P1 | medium |
| 5 | Post and machine registries move to `camcraft-post` | `BUILTINS`, `MACHINES`, `LATHE_POSTS`, `PLASMA_POSTS`, `post_serves` live in post, `app::posting` re-exports them, the 8 registry tests run in `crates/post/tests`; posted output byte-identical (goldens unchanged) | P2 | high |
| 6 | One home for the `.cl` / `.nc` goldens; split `tests/common` | Goldens have one documented home and quick knows which suites read them; the cl-only helpers are usable outside app; `golden_cl` and the 5 generator-fed sim tests run in `crates/motion/tests`, `stock_field_cost` and `warned_moves` (with its module) in sim; sim is in the release heavy lane | P2 | high |
| 7 | Recorded probe toolpaths as post test input | The 6 probe dialect tests, `arc_planes`, `inverted_equivalence`, `inverted_post` and `vertical_arc_entry` run outside app, reading recorded `.cl` input; no new crate edge | P2 | high |
| 8 | Keep `camcraft-post` off `camcraft-tools` | The default-holder check of #880 gets the holder lookup from its caller; `crates/post/Cargo.toml` names no `camcraft-tools`; refusal texts unchanged | P2 | medium |
| 9 | xtask understands directory suites (`tests/<suite>/main.rs`) | `scan`, `quick` and `gate test` list, select and run a directory suite and its changed test fns; pinned by xtask unit tests. Prerequisite for the folding in question 3 and for the fourth rule | P2 | medium |
| 10 | Split sim: stock model below, `verify` above; motion on the stock model only | A change under `sim/src/verify` rebuilds no motion code; `Warning`, `crossed_pairs`, `crossing`, `RotaryAxis` have a home both sides can see; all sim and motion suites pass with the same test count | P2 | max |
| 11 | `mcp`, `script` and `cli` become a crate above app | `camcraft-app` no longer contains them; their 20 test files move with them; the `camcraft-cli` binary and the ui build unchanged in behaviour | P2 | high |

Not proposed for filing until question 1 has timings: layering app into a core and a commands crate (effort max, 15% of app commits benefit), a `geometry::import` crate (nearly no saving), and cutting sim -> tools and motion -> tools (no stable half of tools to depend on).

Sub-issues filed (maintainer picked all four groups, 2026-11-11):

- #922 quick gate: stale Gate maps (P1, bug)
- #923 quick gate: a post-script or machine-file-only change runs no tests (P1, bug)
- #920 the three rules into AGENTS.md (P1)
- #921 move the 12 tests that need nothing from app (P1)
- #926 post scripts tested against the post engine with recorded edge-case toolpath files (raised to P1 on the maintainer's direction: "cps files should be tested against the post binary with a couple of edge case intermediary files to parse")
- #924 post and machine registries into camcraft-post (P2)
- #925 one home for goldens; split tests/common (P2)
- #927 directory test suites in xtask (P2)
- #928 split sim so motion depends on the stock model only (P2, waits for timings)
- #929 mcp / script / cli as a crate above app (P2)

Not filed: proposal 8 (keep camcraft-post off camcraft-tools) - it reverses a dependency the maintainer accepted on PR #880 and waits for their answer.

Still open on this umbrella, so it stays open and claimed: question 1 (rebuild fan-out and timings per crate) and question 3 (what folding test binaries saves) - both need measurements with PR #913's cache in place. Correction to the table in the body: `cl` depends on `geometry`.
